business_summary: Dongwha Enterprise Co.,Ltd operates in the wood industry in South Korea. The company offers board products, such as particle boards (PBs), medium density fiberboards (MDFs), eco-boards, strong structural boards (SSB), and design boards; interior building materials, including flooring and wall panels; and wood panels and lumber products. It also provides chemical materials comprising fine chemical materials consisting of phenolic and melamine resins, urea resins, radiating agent emulsions, emulsions, and aqueous emulsion adhesives; formalin; lithium-ion battery materials; phenolic impregnated surface products, such as TEGO films (phenolic surface films) and core papers (corestock) for high-pressure laminate (HPL) sheets; and melamine impregnated surface products, including overlay, decorative, and pattern papers for HPL sheets, as well as low-pressure melamine (LPM) sheets. In addition, the company offers used-car sales support services, including vehicle performance inspections, quality assurance, transfer registration, and insurance status services, as well as maintenance and commercialization services; media services, such as the Hankook Ilbo and The Korea Times newspapers; culture and content services; and research and development services across the board and interior building materials, fine chemicals, and lithium-ion battery materials sectors. Further, it operates the Montvert golf course. The company was formerly known as Dongwha Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dongwha Enterprise Co.,Ltd in October 2013. Dongwha Enterprise Co.,Ltd was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Incheon, South Korea.
